top_signals.title: Bond Traders Keep Wagers on a September Fed Hike After Tame CPI
top_signals.summary: Traders held on to bets that Federal Reserve officials could raise interest rates at their next meeting in September, pricing in a roughly 40% chance of a move after a tame reading of US inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Jane Street Prices $14.6 Billion Debt Deal With 8% 10-Year Yield
top_signals.summary: Jane Street has issued $14.6 billion of bonds, part of a broader overhaul of its debt load that will also allow it to fund technology infrastructure and expand its trading strategies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Big Wall Street Firms Put Blockchain Experiment to a Bigger Test
top_signals.summary: For four hours in July, some of the biggest players in finance put Wall Street’s long-running blockchain experiment to work across an ordinary trading day.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: US must return to interim deal, no ceasefire extension talks, senior Iranian source says - Reuters
top_signals.summary: US must return to interim deal, no ceasefire extension talks, senior Iranian source says  Reuters
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Kalshi launches sports and crypto perps data feed on DoubleZero
top_signals.summary: Kalshi launched access to its sports and crypto perpetual data feed through DoubleZero’s dedicated fiber network to bolster institutional data access.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
